validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline exists and is real: confirmed via Petroleum News Journal (Oct 2018) which states the Blue Mountain Delivery Project in Grady County, OK with capacity 255 MMcf/d and 10-mile length. Owner Blue Mountain Midstream LLC confirmed via JPT article (Oct 2020) documenting Riviera Resources liquidation and sale of Blue Mountain Midstream to Citizen Energy. Length and location verified as recorded. Capacity shows discrepancy: PGJ source cites 255 MMcf/d vs recorded 225.00 — about 13% variance. No construction year or start year found; project appears to have been shelved/cancelled during or after Riviera Resources' liquidation (Oct 2020). Status shows cancelled with ShelvedYear 2020 and CancelledYear 2022; no dated withdrawal/cancellation order found to confirm the 2022 date.
